notes.title: EX Lv-2 Update
notes.content:
[h3]■Addition of EX Lv-2[/h3]
After clearing EX Lv-1, a new EX Lv-2 will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971550/bae443a4077173d540b8e518e5c9271f71e219a2.png[/img]

notes.title: EX Lv-1 Update
notes.content:
[h3]■Addition of EX Lv-1[/h3]
After clearing Lv-6, a new EX Lv-1 will be added.
EX Lv-2 will be added in the future. (Will probably be added by the end of the next month or two)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971550/2707c43187321a0b7c18387eb7229633f474390b.png[/img]


[h3]■Fixed a problem that prevented the game from starting when SaveData was corrupted.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971550/9aa7edfbb5e5ad029a6117443250d7231976f29d.png[/img]


[h3]■Press F12 key to take a screenshot.[/h3]

notes.title: Mini Update/Patch Notes
notes.content:
■以下のアップデートを行いました。

・エラーが出て起動できない不具合を修正。
・セレクト画面での一部画像の修正

--------------------

■The following updates were made.

・Fixed a bug that prevented starting with an error.
・Fixed some images in Lv select mode.
